text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*... I'm craving something sweet so 
badly right now...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A thin-skinned steamed bun, packed full of 
sweet red bean paste...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yokan sounds nice too... I want to eat 
ohagi, too...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...I'll just buy some from somewhere. I'll 
make it next time...

Sakura Chiyono O might be exhausted. It 
looks like we'll need to reconsider her 
upcoming race schedule.
